About me


I’m a graphic and multimedia designer from Gabès who turns rough ideas into visuals people understand at a glance and remember afterwards.

I’m finishing my Licence in Arts and Mediation, specialising in Communication and Multimedia. My work moves between branding, social media, video and photography, with a little code on the side, which helps me think about how an idea will actually live on screen.

I’ve worked on real briefs for brands across Tunisia, in French and Arabic, and I’m now looking for internships, junior roles and freelance projects where design has to do a job.
